verifiedSurfaceSummary: Native promoted roles and category labels/counts are retained as current observations and reconciled at closing. Generic category counts are not unique vacancy identities. Public application landing titles reveal native role conflicts but application questions, private steps and full-form hashes are not inventory prerequisites. No job description, country, date or requisition is invented from an application label or company address. Incomplete promotions remain observations with no persistence candidates; company/India vacancy totals remain unknown.
